note: The one list of steering-wheel name keywords. Read by detectProfile in src/game/controlProfiles.js and by looks_like_wheel in src-tauri/src/wheel.rs; a device whose name contains any of these, case-insensitively, is a wheel. It decides which leaderboard a run lands on. Vendors that also make gamepads (Logitech, Thrustmaster) are listed by model rather than by name, because a bare vendor token put their gamepads on the wheel board.
